rows.label: qst630205_msg0001
rows.name: Can it be...? Is the hat ready?

rows.label: qst630205_msg0003
rows.name:
Show me right away. I'll try it on and
see if it suits me.

rows.label: qst630205_msg0004
rows.name: Well? Do you think it looks stylish?

rows.label: qst630205_msg0005
rows.name: What do you think about Rugena's hat?

rows.label: qst630205_msg0202
rows.name:
And here I thought it
was pretty great...

rows.label: qst630205_msg0203
rows.name: What? You wanna try for another one?

rows.label: qst630205_msg0301
rows.name:
Now I can finally go shopping with my
friends and show off this hat.

rows.label: qst630205_msg0302
rows.name:
I used to think Dad was a strange guy,
but I should thank him for sending
someone so useful.

rows.label: qst630205_msg0303
rows.name:
Right, I'll give you the reward now.
It'd be a hassle to go see that old
man again, right?

rows.label: qst630205_msg0304
rows.name:
Huh? Was that too much for a reward?
Don't worry about it.
